description:
Next single milestone for the unreleased Jido Console project.

Goal:
Address every accepted finding from the complete jido_console simplification audit.

Work boundary:
- 30 child tasks, one for each retained finding.
- Simplify data structures, state, control flow, algorithms, and ownership.
- Convert the project to use Splode errors as the single error system.
- Do not add backward-compatibility aliases, deprecation periods, legacy decoders, or old-arity shims.
- Preserve intentional trust boundaries and separate owners identified by the audit.

Exit gate:
- All 30 child tasks are closed.
- All task acceptance checks pass.
- The dependency graph is complete.
- The complete product and release validation set passes.
- No accepted audit finding remains unresolved.

Priority:
P0. This epic is the next work before any later milestone or feature work.
title: Milestone: Simplify the Unreleased Jido Console Codebase
